summary: Perspective Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing via press release that the FDA granted Fast Track Designation for PSV359, a 212Pb-labeled FAP-targeted alpha-particle therapy, in adult patients with locally advanced unresectable and/or metastatic FAP-positive solitary fibrous tumors. The registrant is the filer and issuer of the disclosure. No financial terms, securities, stakes, prices, premiums, board recommendations, advisors, or transaction mechanics are mentioned; this is a regulatory designation update, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle applies.
